title: The Nature Book
setting: A bright living room with a large picture book on a table.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: Ben and Lily read a big picture book.
sentences.zh: 本和莉莉在看一本大图画书。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) sit at a table with a large open picture book.

sentences.en: One page shows snow and ice on a mountain.
sentences.zh: 有一页画着山上的雪和冰。
sentences.scene_prompt: An open picture book page showing a tall mountain covered in snow and ice, seen over the shoulders of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots).

sentences.en: Next, a lion sleeps on the sunny grass.
sentences.zh: 接着，一头狮子睡在洒满阳光的草地上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a lion sleeping on green grass under bright sun, Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) pointing at it.

sentences.en: A tall giraffe eats leaves from a tree.
sentences.zh: 一只高高的长颈鹿在吃树上的叶子。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree.

sentences.en: A little bird sits on the giraffe's head.
sentences.zh: 一只小鸟停在长颈鹿的头上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a small bird sitting on top of a giraffe's head.

sentences.en: In the rain, small plants grow very fast.
sentences.zh: 在雨中，小植物长得很快。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing rain falling on small green plants sprouting from the ground.
sentences.draw_note: Shows rain on small sprouting plants; 'very fast' can't be shown.

sentences.en: A dog sleeps by a warm fire at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节时，一只狗睡在温暖的炉火旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: A picture book page showing a dog sleeping by a warm fireplace next to a Christmas tree.

sentences.en: Ben helps Lily understand the long words.
sentences.zh: 本帮莉莉弄懂那些长单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) points at the open book and explains while Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) nods with a happy face.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben explaining the book to a nodding Lily; understanding and the long words can't be shown.
